title: Binary product comparison for right derived functors
statement: In an abelian category C with injective resolutions [def-sp-abelian, def-sp-injective-resolutions], for additive functors A,B,D,E to abelian groups [def-sp-left-exact-additive], transformations a:A→B,b:A→D,c:B→E,d:D→E, object M and degree n, the right derived pointwise Cartesian product B×D is isomorphic to R^n B(M)×R^n D(M). Under this isomorphism the derived pair map (a,b) is (R^n a,R^n b), and the derived difference map c-d is R^n c-R^n d.

source.place: Tag 0A50, passage from an injective section sequence to the homology long exact sequence; Homology Tag 0117

proof.text: Construct the pointwise Cartesian product functor, its pair and difference transformations, and its projections and inclusions by additive homomorphisms. Check naturality componentwise.

Compute derived components with rightDerived_app_eq. Additivity of the homology functor shows right derivation preserves addition and zero. Composition and identities are already preserved by Mathlib.

Derive the five projection-inclusion identities. The derived projections yield the forward product comparison and the sum of derived inclusions its inverse. Derive the equations for the pair composed with projections and for the difference written as pc+q(-d).

proof_origin.place: Tag 0A50, passage from an injective section sequence to the homology long exact sequence; Homology Tag 0117
proof_origin.note: M1 concrete Lean argument, using the Mathlib resolution and homology APIs.

lean.statement:
theorem rightDerived_binaryProduct_iso
    [Abelian C] [HasInjectiveResolutions C]
    (A B D E : C ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{w})
    [A.Additive] [B.Additive] [D.Additive] [E.Additive]
    (a : A ⟶ B) (b : A ⟶ D) (c : B ⟶ E) (d : D ⟶ E)
    (M : C) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ e : ((abBinaryProduct B D).rightDerived n).obj M ≅
        AddCommGrpCat.of ((B.rightDerived n).obj M × (D.rightDerived n).obj M),
      (∀ x, e.hom (((abBinaryProductLift a b).rightDerived n).app M x) =
        ((a.rightDerived n).app M x, (b.rightDerived n).app M x)) ∧
      (∀ x, ((abBinaryProductDifference c d).rightDerived n).app M x =
        (c.rightDerived n).app M (e.hom x).1 -
          (d.rightDerived n).app M (e.hom x).2)
